document.abstract: This paper describes a new high quality de-interlacing algorithm applying motion estimation and compensation techniques. First, a comparison between two recently introduced de-interlacing concepts will be presented. One method is based on a generalized sampling theorem and the other uses time-recursion. The new algorithm aims at combining the benefits of both.
